csv_project_name: AE for Joseph A Foran High School Pool Renovation
csv_scope_of_work: The Milford Public Schools is seeking a qualified architectural and engineering firm, with specialized expertise in aquatic facilities, to conduct a comprehensive assessment of the swimming pool at Foran High School (constructed in 1973). The facility is currently experiencing significant water loss from unidentified sources. The goal of this study is to determine the current condition of the facility, identify the source of failures, and provide a strategic roadmap for remediation, modernization, or full replacement

title: A/E Services for Joseph A. Foran High School Pool Renovation
short_description: Assessment and renovation planning for a leaking high school swimming pool facility.
project_scope: Comprehensive assessment of the swimming pool facility at Joseph A. Foran High School in Milford, Connecticut. The pool was constructed in 1973 and is experiencing significant water loss from unidentified sources. The assignment includes determining the current condition of the facility, identifying failure sources, and developing a strategic roadmap for remediation, modernization, or full replacement of the aquatic facility. Stated total construction cost is 5.3 million.
services: Architectural and engineering services with specialized aquatic facility expertise, including feasibility studies, structural engineering, architecture, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, and cost estimating.
relevance_explanation:
- Existing building rehabilitation project focused on a school swimming pool facility.
- Includes structural engineering and assessment scope, which creates some relevance.
- However, the project is primarily a building rehabilitation/feasibility assignment rather than a complex long-span, bridge, roof, or special structure.
- Strong involvement of architecture, MEP, and aquatic facility specialization reduces fit with sbp's core profile.
- Moderate strategic value only due to refurbishment and possible structural input.
fee_explanation: No explicit design fee stated in the source. Available fee-related basis: A/E services for assessment, feasibility, and potential remediation/replacement planning of a pool renovation project with total construction cost of 5.3 million USD.
references_qualifications: Qualified architectural and engineering firm with specialized expertise in aquatic facilities. Up to 4 firms may be selected.
contracting_authority: City of Milford Public Schools, Milford, CT, USA. Contact: Fred Bialka. Phone: 203-783-3225. Email: fbialka@milfordct.gov. Website: https://www.milfordct.us/863/Current-Bids
notes: Project number 1846. Mandatory pre-submittal meeting on 2026-06-01 03:00 AM EDT at 80 Foran Rd, Milford, CT 06460, USA. Questions deadline: 2026-06-10 05:00 PM EDT. Source states the pool was constructed in 1973 and the study may lead to remediation, modernization, or full replacement.
